basic_details.job_title: ICAR-CIBA Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-Central Institute of Brackishwater Aquaculture (CIBA), Chennai, is engaging one Young Professional-II at Rs. 42,000 per month (consolidated), for which a postgraduate degree (M.Tech / M.Sc.) in Bioinformatics or Computational Biology is the essential qualification, and one Young Professional-I at Rs. 30,000 per month (consolidated), for which an undergraduate degree in the listed fields is required. The posts are under the CCF ICAR National Priority Project on the algal and bacterial microbiome and shrimp productivity, on a purely temporary basis. Applications are to be submitted through

important_dates.interview_date: Will be intimated in mail to the qualified candidates

age_limit.details: For both posts the lower age limit is 21 years and the upper age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is as per Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print a date for counting age.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates may submit their application, clearly indicating their experience and skills/instruments used, along with contact numbers, in the prescribed proforma only, with scanned copies of the certificates, through https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 30 November 2026.
Download the application form (the prescribed proforma attached to the notice) and type it clearly.
Fill in the form for the post of YP II / YP I, including the education details required by the post's essential qualification.
Sign the form and attach all required documents. Number the supporting documents serially as Annexures and refer to them in the form at the relevant places.
Upload all documents as a single merged PDF file.
Name the PDF file UNRAVELLING << Applicant First Name >>30112026.pdf.
Attach the PDF file in the application available on the website https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ by 30 November 2026.
Degree certificates, experience certificates and research papers DOI etc.
Scan copy of the SC/ST/OBC certificate, where a category is claimed.
Scan copy of the NET / GATE certificate, if qualified.
Scan copies of certificates for university awards, medals or conference best presentation awards.

The proforma also asks for personal and contact details, date of birth and age, qualification details, research papers published in SCI journals with citation, patents filed or granted, work experience in project/industry/aquaculture, thesis or dissertation title, an abstract (maximum 150 words) and a Statement of Purpose in a maximum of one page.
important_instructions: An application without the required documents (degree certificates, experience certificates, research papers DOI etc.) may be rejected. ICAR-CIBA does not enter into correspondence with applicants for not calling them for interview. Director, CIBA reserves right to accept or reject any applications. The engagement is purely temporary. The notice lists these contact details: phone 044-24618817, 24616948; fax 044-24610311; email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CIBA
content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Institute of Brackishwater Aquaculture is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research at Chennai. The notice is issued from its administration section (F.No. 39(379)/2026-Admn, dated 16.11.2026). The two posts serve a National Priority Project funded from the Central Corpus Fund of ICAR, which studies the algal and bacterial microbiome and its association with shrimp productivity in shrimp farming through an omics approach.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces two vacancies in total, one in each post. It does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Both posts require a first division or 60% marks, or an equivalent overall grade point average, in the essential degree. Prior experience in bioinformatics for a minimum of 2 year, preferably working knowledge on bioinformatics and microbial metagenomics. Microbial identification, sequence analysis, annotation, and phylogenetic analysis using relevant bioinformatics tools and databases (NCBI, BLAST, QIIME2, MEGA, R, etc.) will be an added merit. Experience in microbial metagenomics, handling live animals and conduct of shrimp biological experiments will be an added advantage. Prior experience in microbiology lab work for a minimum of 2 years, preferably handling of bacterial and algal cultures and molecular biotechnology techniques. Practical knowledge on DNA extraction, PCR, RT-PCR, gel documentation will be an added merit. Working experience in the sample collection in shrimp farming system, handling live animals and actively participating in conduct of shrimp biological experiments will be an added advantage. For both posts the lower age limit is 21 years and the upper age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is as per Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print a date for counting age.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate Degree (M. tech / M.Sc.) in Bioinformatics or Computational Biology with 1st division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average
Undergraduate Degree (B.F.Sc./ B.Tech./B.Sc.) in Professional Fisheries Science/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Zoology with 1st division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Young Professional-II post carries Rs. 42,000 per month (consolidated) and the Young Professional-I post Rs. 30,000 per month (consolidated). The engagement is on a purely temporary basis of the institute. The duration is one year initially, and it may be extended for a further period of two years (one year at a time) based on satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIBA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may submit their application, clearly indicating their experience and skills/instruments used, along with contact numbers, in the prescribed proforma only, with scanned copies of the certificates, through https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 30 November 2026. Download the application form (the prescribed proforma attached to the notice) and type it clearly. Fill in the form for the post of YP II / YP I, including the education details required by the post's essential qualification. Sign the form and attach all required documents. Number the supporting documents serially as Annexures and refer to them in the form at the relevant places. Upload all documents as a single merged PDF file. Name the PDF file UNRAVELLING << Applicant First Name >>30112026.pdf. Attach the PDF file in the application available on the website https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ by 30 November 2026. Degree certificates, experience certificates and research papers DOI etc. Scan copy of the SC/ST/OBC certificate, where a category is claimed. Scan copy of the NET / GATE certificate, if qualified. Scan copies of certificates for university awards, medals or conference best presentation awards. The proforma also asks for personal and contact details, date of birth and age, qualification details, research papers published in SCI journals with citation, patents filed or granted, work experience in project/industry/aquaculture, thesis or dissertation title, an abstract (maximum 150 words) and a Statement of Purpose in a maximum of one page.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Communication will only be sent to the short-listed candidates for attending the interview. The interview is in offline mode at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai. Its date and time will be intimated by mail to the qualified candidates. Candidates who have received the mail should appear with the required documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CIBA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Young Professional-II and one Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of biodata is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate Degree (M. tech / M.Sc.) in Bioinformatics or Computational Biology with 1st division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: An Undergraduate Degree (B.F.Sc./ B.Tech./B.Sc.) in Professional Fisheries Science/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Zoology with 1st division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The lower age limit is 21 years and the upper age limit is 45 years, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Young Professional-II gets Rs. 42,000 per month and Young Professional-I gets Rs. 30,000 per month, both consolidated.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed proforma, attach the certificates as a single merged PDF named UNRAVELLING << Applicant First Name >>30112026.pdf, and attach it in the application on https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be called for the interview?
faq.answer: Short-listed candidates will be informed by mail, and the interview is in offline mode at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai. The date and time will be intimated by mail to qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on a purely temporary basis for one year initially, and it may be extended for a further period of two years (one year at a time) based on satisfactory performance.
